en: The front side of the postcard depicts an old stone church, labeled 'Alnö gamla kyrka.' The church exhibits traditional Scandinavian medieval architecture with a steep, gabled roof and adjoining chapel, situated amidst trees and rocky terrain. In the background, another church with a tall, pointed steeple is visible. The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text, a Swedish 10 öre postage stamp, and an address. The postmark and other typography are in Swedish.
